## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] `corepack pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run lint`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run test`
- [ ] `corepack pnpm run build`
- [ ] Relevant focused verifier or manual check

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No API key, token, private data, or generated secret is included.
- [ ] Documentation and tests reflect behavior changes.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visible interface changes.

## Notes

List known limitations, follow-up work, and compatibility considerations.
